. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
For the class of recreational-type NPA's with offroad capability, the gasoline savings from the viewpoint
that only those impacts resulting from actions taken by
manufacturers to meet the AFES over and above their
voluntary plans are attributable to the AFES are the
same as those for the other viewpoint which were previously
described. The reason for this is that the manufacturers'
plans in MY 1979 produce a fuel economy the same as MY 1976.
Again, these plans include the maximum fuel economy penalty
of the emission standard and gasoline savings would be less\nif the penalty is less.
The combined fleet savings for both classes would be between 10.7 million gallons and 35 million gallons per year and 107 million gallons and 350 million gallons for the lifetime of the fleet.
